pre-fix-yarn.meaning: "660 feet (200 metres) apart, at a height of 330 feet (100 metres)" preserves the operational measurements; contractors, minerals, locations and safety conditions are also retained.
pre-fix-yarn.sense: "sizing up geothermal energy potential" and "signed up NRG Exploration USA Inc. and Woolpert" carry assessment and contracting correctly.
pre-fix-yarn.authenticity: "a fair few kinds of mineral deposits" and "The choppers" sound naturally Australian rather than a string of stock slogans.
pre-fix-yarn.register: "kick off", "heaps" and "Now, these scientific instruments" provide a consistent moderate oral voice appropriate to level 3.
pre-fix-yarn.tone: "no emissions that pose any risk to people, animals or plants" retains the public reassurance, and the account remains informative throughout.
pre-fix-yarn.flow: "the groundwork geological data to back future mineral exploration" is awkwardly compounded, although the surrounding long technical account remains clear.
pre-fix-yarn.variety: "takes in a chunk", "sizing up", "signed up" and "goes up free for anyone" vary the idioms and sentence movement.
pre-fix-yarn.essence: "They won't be taking any photos or video, either" retains the public-facing explanation of what the conspicuous flights will and will not do.

current.meaning: "identify energy and groundwater resources and natural hazards" and "daylight hours only" preserve the aims and restrictions; the detailed lists and quoted authorities remain intact.
current.sense: "plenty of scope for exploration and production" accurately retains potential without implying certain discoveries.
current.authenticity: "takes in part of eastern California" and "in line with U.S. law" are unforced idiomatic English that an Australian could naturally use.
current.register: "The USGS has engaged" and "No photography or video data will be collected" exemplify a largely formal account with little level-3 vernacular.
current.tone: "They work with the FAA to keep the flights safe" keeps the informative, reassuring institutional purpose.
current.flow: "Flights will operate out of Bishop and Lone Pine airports. They'll fly over" splits the location details neatly and the technical material reads cleanly.
current.variety: "takes in", "to build on" and "Anyone can freely access" provide varied phrasing without verbal tics.
current.essence: "Anyone can freely access the collected data on the USGS ScienceBase website" preserves the open-data conclusion and the notice's public-service shape.

dinkum-3.meaning: "there's still a fair bit left to find and dig up out there" asserts remaining material more confidently than exploration and production potential; otherwise the extensive detail survives.
dinkum-3.sense: "suss out" fits identifying resources and hazards, and "above board under U.S. law" fits legal compliance.
dinkum-3.authenticity: "a fair bit", "choppers" and "sizing up" are natural Australian expressions that fit the subject matter.
dinkum-3.register: "Keep an eye on the sky" and "Don't stress" create a sustained conversational account with moderate local idiom and no excessive vulgarity.
dinkum-3.tone: "Don't stress: the scientific instruments are totally passive" retains the reassuring purpose, but "drag the nation’s maps" adds a mildly critical attitude.
dinkum-3.flow: "The USGS has contracted NRG Exploration USA Inc. and Woolpert to do the collecting" is clear and relaxed; the lengthy technical lists remain well connected.
dinkum-3.variety: "team effort", "suss out", "chock-full", "Think" and "above board" supply varied oral phrasing.
dinkum-3.essence: "No photos or video will be taken, either" and the precise flight specifications retain the notice's practical focus and distinctive technical content.

pre-fix-yarn.why: Groundwork used directly before geological data is a clumsy noun pile-up aloud.

current.quote: The USGS has engaged NRG Exploration USA Inc. and Woolpert
current.original: The USGS has contracted NRG Exploration USA Inc. and Woolpert
current.why: This formal wording represents the consistently light vernacular, substantially below the moderate register requested.

dinkum-3.quote: there's still a fair bit left to find and dig up out there
dinkum-3.original: The survey areas still have significant exploration and production potential.
dinkum-3.why: Potential for exploration and production does not establish that appreciable material is definitely left to extract.

dinkum-3.quote: drag the nation’s maps of geology and mineral resources up to date
dinkum-3.original: modernize the nation’s maps of geology and mineral resources
dinkum-3.why: Drag adds a faint suggestion of reluctant or deficient modernisation beyond the neutral stated aim.

summaries.pre-fix-yarn: A complete technical notice in a well-judged conversational register, with one awkward phrase.
summaries.current: Precise and especially easy to follow, but too close to neutral official prose for the brief.
summaries.dinkum-3: An engaging, natural explanation that keeps the technical substance, with a small certainty shift and a slightly editorial verb.
